程序包 org.bukkit

接口 Chunk

public interface Chunk
Represents a chunk of blocks 代表一个由方块组成的区块

    • getChunkSnapshot

      ChunkSnapshot getChunkSnapshot()
      Capture thread-safe read-only snapshot of chunk data 捕获区块数据的线程安全只读快照
      返回:
      ChunkSnapshot 区块快照

    • getChunkSnapshot

      ChunkSnapshot getChunkSnapshot(boolean includeMaxblocky, boolean includeBiome, boolean includeBiomeTempRain)
      Capture thread-safe read-only snapshot of chunk data
      参数:
      includeMaxblocky - - if true, snapshot includes per-coordinate maximum Y values 若为 true，快照将包含每个坐标的最大 Y 值
      includeBiome - - if true, snapshot includes per-coordinate biome type 若为 true，快照将包含每个坐标的生物群系类型
      includeBiomeTempRain - - if true, snapshot includes per-coordinate raw biome temperature and rainfall 若为 true，快照将包含每个坐标的原始生物群系温度与降雨量
      返回:
      ChunkSnapshot

    • load

      boolean load(boolean generate)
      Loads the chunk. 加载区块。
      参数:
      generate - Whether or not to generate a chunk if it doesn't already exist 如果区块不存在，是否生成新区块
      返回:
      true if the chunk has loaded successfully, otherwise false 如果区块加载成功则为 true，否则为 false

    • load

      boolean load()

      true if the chunk has loaded successfully, otherwise false 如果区块加载成功则为 true，否则为 false

    • unload

      boolean unload(boolean save, boolean safe)
      Unloads and optionally saves the Chunk 卸载区块，并可选择是否保存
      参数:
      save - Controls whether the chunk is saved 控制是否保存该区块
      safe - Controls whether to unload the chunk when players are nearby 控制当有玩家在附近时是否卸载该区块
      返回:
      true if the chunk has unloaded successfully, otherwise false 如果区块卸载成功则为 true，否则为 false
